content.scenario: The Consumer Mediation Cell of the National Commission has a mediator whose term is about to expire. The mediator has expressed interest in being re-empaneled for another term. The Authority must provide for the re-empanelment of mediators under sub-section (3) of section 75.
content.outcome: The Authority will provide for the re-empanelment of the mediator for another term under sub-section (3) of section 75, as per the regulations made under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the process for re-empanelment of mediators?
Can a mediator be re-empaneled for another term?
What are the conditions for re-empanelment of mediators?
